<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sigmafi/orders/{boxId}/fill"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lend the principal to the borrower. The fill mints two units with the order's box id as token id: one circulating claim to this wallet and one singleton locked in the bond. Whoever holds the claim receives the repayment, or the collateral less its batching fee after maturity liquidation.
